main_body: Broad leafy tree canopy made of several leaf clumps, with a root-flared trunk and branches below
top_band: Light green (#93c144, L~164) leaf surface at rows 1-5 on the centre column, stepping down to mid and dark greens below
evidence: Each leaf clump has a light upper surface (rows 1-5, 8-9, 28-31) that steps down to darker green undersides. The layered clumps cast shade onto the tones below, and the trunk with exposed roots sits below the canopy. This reads as a lit-from-above volume with a front face, not a flat elevation. No isometric side face is drawn. The organic kind fits.

style.evidence: The candidate has 109 colours per tile against 108 and 109 for the references. It has 554 distinct colours, more than tree-1a786c (427) and about the same as tree-d43edd (567). Flat-fill coverage is 0%, and only 1% of dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outlines are tinted dark green and brown. Leaf clumps use several greens from deep green to bright lime. The trunk has brown grain and the roots carry small leaf tufts. Beside the references it looks equally rich and not sticker-like.
